import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exps = ['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
d = df.dropna(subset=exps+['yield_kg']).copy()
# shade effect with farm only
m = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ shade_pct + C(farm)', data=d).fit()
print("shade+farm:", m.params['shade_pct'], m.pvalues['shade_pct'])
# add quadratic
d['shade2']=d['shade_pct']**2
m2 = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ shade_pct + shade2 + C(farm)', data=d).fit()
print("quad:", m2.params['shade_pct'], m2.pvalues['shade_pct'], m2.params['shade2'], m2.pvalues['shade2'])
# interaction with farm
m3 = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ shade_pct*C(farm)', data=d).fit()
print("interaction p:", m3.pvalues.filter(like='shade_pct').to_dict())
# robust
m4 = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ shade_pct + C(farm)', data=d).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print("HC3:", m4.params['shade_pct'], m4.pvalues['shade_pct'])
# check other exposures with full model but drop shade
m5 = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ ' + ' + '.join([e for e in exps if e!='shade_pct']) + ' + C(farm)', data=d).fit()
print(m5.pvalues[[e for e in exps if e!='shade_pct']])
